name: io.github.stevecrates489-commits/tokcalc
title: tokcalc MCP Server
description: Open-source LLM serving capacity planner for AI agents. 7 read-only tools: estimate_capacity, compare_gpus, recommend_topology, estimate_api_vs_self_host, list_models, list_gpus, get_mlperf_benchmarks. Supports stdio (npx install for Cursor/Claude Desktop) + Streamable HTTP (public hosted endpoint at tokcalc.vercel.app/api/mcp with bearer auth + rate limiting).
